svg.text: ── everything below this line is OUTSIDE the loop, to its RIGHT. Folded down to fit the page. ──
Every shift register is initialised OUTSIDE the loop. Leave one unwired and it keeps the value from the previous
run of the VI — the classic "it passes the first time and fails after that" bug.
The Select node beside the loop IS the whole error policy: if the error cluster says status = true, the next state
is Evaluate no matter what the case wanted. One node, every state covered.
Clear Errors runs AFTER the loop, so the safing command (SYS:CONT OPEN) still executes even when every
state before it failed. Without it, DUT_Query would see an error in and do nothing.
legend: grey = TCP refnum, olive/thick = cluster (error, limits, Result, TestData), blue = enum + I32, orange = DBL, pink = string, green = boolean
